title: Kitchen Renovation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Full kitchen renovation for an L-shaped kitchen, approximately 3.5 metres by 2.8 metres. Includes demolition of existing kitchen. New cabinetry: five 600mm wide soft-close drawer units, one 900mm corner blind cabinet, one 800mm sink base cabinet, all in a laminate finish. Wall cabinets: three 900mm wide x 720mm high units, one 600mm wide x 720mm high unit over fridge. Tall cabinet: one 600mm wide x 2100mm high pantry unit. Benchtops: 8.5 square metres of 20mm engineered stone, with one waterfall end (0.9m x 0.6m panel). Sink and tapware: Franke double bowl stainless steel undermount sink (780x440mm) and a chrome pull-out mixer tap. Appliances: Bosch 600mm electric wall oven (HBF113BR0A), Bosch 900mm induction cooktop (PXV975DC1E), and a Schweigen 900mm ducted rangehood (DS3170-9S). Splashback: 6 square metres of glossy white subway tiles (75x150mm), laid in a brick bond pattern. Electrical: Demolition and re-fit of ten new double power points, installation of one dedicated circuit for the oven, and three new downlights. Plumbing: Demolition and re-fit of hot/cold connections for the sink, new dishwasher point, and new connection for a fridge water dispenser.
workingDetail: Cabinetry (base, wall, tall), Stone or laminate benchtop, Sink and tapware, Appliances (oven, cooktop, rangehood)
